description: This file contains miscellaneous utility functions for distributed training, tensor handling, and system info, specifically tailored for object detection projects using PyTorch and torchvision.

classes.name: SmoothedValue
classes.description: Tracks a series of values and provides smoothed statistics like median, average, max, and global average.

classes.name: MetricLogger
classes.description: Logs and manages multiple SmoothedValue meters, supports distributed synchronization, and formatted logging.

classes.name: NestedTensor
classes.description: Encapsulates a tensor and an optional mask, with methods for device transfer and decomposition.

methods.name: get_sha
methods.description: Retrieves current Git commit SHA, branch, and diff status.

methods.name: collate_fn
methods.description: Collates a batch of data, converting the first element into a NestedTensor.

methods.name: setup_for_distributed
methods.description: Overrides the print function to disable printing on non-master processes.

methods.name: is_dist_avail_and_initialized
methods.description: Checks if distributed training is available and initialized.

methods.name: get_world_size
methods.description: Returns the total number of processes in distributed training.

methods.name: get_rank
methods.description: Returns the rank of the current process.

methods.name: is_main_process
methods.description: Checks if the current process is the main process (rank 0).

methods.name: save_on_master
methods.description: Saves a model or data only if in the main process.

methods.name: init_distributed_mode
methods.description: Initializes distributed training environment based on environment variables.

methods.name: accuracy
methods.description: Computes top-k accuracy metrics for model outputs.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Performs tensor interpolation with support for empty tensors, compatible with different torchvision versions.
